title: Super Mario 64 USA analog input sweep, sanitized runtime observations

baseline.restoreMethod: Project64 UI Load State F7 before each trial; visually verified courtyard, lives 4, stars 0

excludedTrials: Earlier attract/demo-screen captures and attempts without an aligned bounded capture plus guarded hold window were excluded from calibration claims.

romTransformCrossCheck.transform: raw axis -7..+7 -> 0; <=-8 add 6; >=8 subtract 6; radial magnitude cap 64

endState.portableClone: Closed after captures; active Project64.cfg restored byte-for-byte from the pre-N-Rage clone backup
endState.restoredInputPlugin: Project64 input plugin 3.0.1.5664-2df3434; clone config [Input-Controller 1] stores Deadzone=1 and Range=5
endState.preservedCalibration: N-Rage-selected clone config and final N-Rage INI snapshot retained locally

sampler.counter: 0x8032D5D4; diagnostic only, not an emulated-frame guarantee
sampler.startedMarker: hostUnixMs and trialId logged when callback starts; use a unique timestamped trialId and verify the new marker before guarded input
sampler.guardedInputTargets: Installed or Issue11 portable Project64 executable, pinned by exact path and SHA-256
